description: Timelines plot events and milestones along a date axis — for roadmaps, project schedules, release histories, and infographics where chronology matters. A flexible alternative to a Gantt chart when your story is driven by dates and events. New in 2.0: mini-charts per event, click-to-filter on headings, and layout controls for crowded timelines. Highlights: Mini-charts per event — render a numeric field as a Bar, Blocks, Dot, Ring, or color/gradient Chip beside each event, with data labels, per-event colors, and gradient fills. Small multiples — show one timeline line per category, with a shared or independent date scale and alternating band backgrounds. Control formatting through your data — drive event colors and mini-chart colors straight from a column or DAX color expression (conditional, data-driven formatting). Click to cross-filter — click an event or a date heading to filter the rest of the report. Layout optimization — equal or proportional event spacing, range padding, and minimum line-spacing keep dense, crowded timelines readable.
